Hello, you should try using the 'Pulse Relay' block. The 'trg' input in this block should meet your requirements exactly. Refer to the attached screenshot. Good luck!
It sounds like you need a pulse relay. See the attached file.

Just to clarify, on the first button press a menu appears, and on the second press another menu opens. Also, after the second press, a stop part of the circuit should be activated, not just turning it off. Hope that helps explain.

Could you provide more details, please?

The second press starts the process and shows another message about the current temperature and remaining time. The third press stops the process. I’ve managed to set up all of these actions, but I still can’t reset the counter.
